NPI_DEFECTS.title: Handheld 32GB eMMC operational storage headroom insufficient for Phase XIV reduced profile
NPI_DEFECTS.summary: Preferred RM121-D8E32 markets 32.0GB but Phase XIV handheld-reduced profile requires 31.5GB (marketed free=0.5GB). After typical eMMC format overhead (~6%), estimated usable≈29.76GB leaves usable_free=-1.74GB. Below operational minima (2.0GB absolute or 10% free). Phase XIV mathematical fit on marketed capacity does not equal operationally safe field headroom.
recommended_actions: Select larger onboard storage SKU (≥64GB eMMC/UFS or NVMe) for EVT0 preferred Handheld config, OR
Further reduce handheld profile (games cache / AI nano footprint) until usable_free≥2GB and ≥10%, OR
Require external/user-media storage for games+projects with enforced onboard reserve policy
